title: Booking Terms by Pass — Tailwise Grooming Salon
content:
Every Tailwise Grooming Salon pass sets its own booking terms. The figures below are the ones an appointment on that pass is booked against.

| Pass | Farthest ahead a date may be booked | Open bookings at one time | Minimum days between two appointment dates | Current rabies certificate required | Pets flagged muzzle required accepted | First visit booked with an assessment slot |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Express Bath Pass 3-Visit | 30 days | 1 | 7 | yes | no | no |
| Bath & Tidy Pass 4-Visit | 30 days | 1 | 7 | yes | no | no |
| Full Groom Pass 4-Visit | 45 days | 2 | 7 | yes | yes | yes |
| Full Groom Pass 6-Visit | 45 days | 2 | 7 | yes | yes | yes |
| Spa Groom Pass 6-Visit | 60 days | 2 | 7 | yes | yes | yes |
| Groom Club Monthly | 60 days | 1 | 14 | yes | yes | yes |

**What each column means**

- *Farthest ahead* — the largest number of days ahead that an appointment may be booked.
- *Open bookings* — booked appointments on one pass that may be open at the same time, an open booking being one dated today or later that has not been cancelled, completed or recorded as a no-show.
- *Minimum days between dates* — the fewest calendar days that must separate two appointment dates on the same pass.
- *Rabies certificate* — whether a current rabies certificate must be on file for the appointment date.
- *Muzzle required* — whether a pet flagged muzzle required may be serviced on this pass at all.
- *Assessment slot* — whether a pet new to Tailwise salons has its first visit booked with an extra assessment slot.

**Comparing passes (hypothetical)**

- A customer on the Bath & Tidy Pass 4-Visit with one appointment already open cannot hold a second open booking on that pass (limit 1); on the Full Groom Pass 4-Visit the same customer could hold two.
- On Groom Club Monthly two appointment dates must be at least 14 days apart; on every prepaid pass the figure is 7.
- A pet flagged muzzle required is not accepted on the Express Bath Pass 3-Visit or the Bath & Tidy Pass 4-Visit; the other passes accept it.
